clue.text: More than one girl gathered round old piano dances

indicators.note: the girls are gathered round the following letters, so they enclose them

parts.note: girls in the plural are gals
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: A group of girls crowd round an ancient piano to dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A galop is a lively nineteenth-century ballroom dance, so the plural names several such dances.

clue.text: Source of energy is sun, acquired in short supply outside

indicators.note: the shortened word for acquired sits outside the sun, holding it
short means the last letter is cut from the word for acquired

parts.note: gained means acquired
Sol is the Latin name for the sun

explanation.surface: The sun is a source of energy that is scarce around us.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in short supply' trims GAINED to GAINE, which goes 'outside' SOL.
explanation.definitionFit: Gasoline, the American word for petrol, is a fuel and so a source of energy.

clue.text: Find out about knight following king

indicators.note: the knight comes following, so after, the king

parts.note: Lear is Shakespeare's legendary king
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: Discover details of a knight who served a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: To learn about something is to discover or be told of it.

clue.text: Chum has hesitation, wanting little time in Italian city

parts.note: a pal is a chum or friend
er is the sound of hesitating
a mo is a short moment

explanation.surface: A friend dithers, lacking a moment to spare, in an Italian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Palermo is the capital of Sicily, a major city in Italy.

clue.text: Passage that accommodates retreating soldiers

indicators.note: the word that accommodates, or holds within it, the reversed soldiers

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: soldiers retreating go backwards, so their letters are read in reverse

parts.note: OR stands for Other Ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A corridor or alley that offers shelter to troops falling back.
explanation.definitionFit: The throat is the passage from mouth to stomach and lungs, so it is a bodily passage.

clue.text: Technical problem maybe in English town

parts.note: a hitch is a snag, such as a technical problem

explanation.surface: A technical fault, perhaps, in a town in England.
explanation.definitionFit: Hitchin is a market town in Hertfordshire, a county just north of London.

clue.text: Turn too sharply, it being tricky to reverse

indicators.note: the phrase to reverse is tricky, awkwardly mixed up, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A driver who swings round too hard because backing up is awkward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reverse' hints at a reversal but is anagram fodder with 'to'.
explanation.definitionFit: A car that oversteers turns more sharply than the driver intends, swinging the rear out.

clue.text: Organised crime of those people undermined by old boy

indicators.note: in a down clue the first part sits above, so it is undermined by the next piece placed below it

parts.note: them means those people
OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

explanation.surface: Gangsters brought down by a former schoolmate.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mob is the familiar name for the Mafia, the archetype of organised crime.

clue.text: Seafood that could make you collapse

indicators.note: the letters of the next word could make the answer if rearranged

explanation.surface: A warning that some shellfish dish might make you keel over.
explanation.definitionFit: An escallop is another spelling of scallop, a shellfish eaten as seafood.

clue.text: Showing remorse in Lent, i.e. apt to reform

indicators.note: reform means form again, so the letters are reshaped into a new order

explanation.surface: A penitent remark that Lent is the right season to change your ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Penitential means expressing repentance, the feeling of being sorry for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Watery holiday area planned round a particular idea

definitions.meaning: the Med, short for the Mediterranean Sea, a popular holiday region
describes an event or venue built around one subject, as in a fancy-dress party

explanation.surface: A seaside resort designed around a single concept.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition splits as THE MED, the Mediterranean; the second reads the same letters as one word.
explanation.definitionFit: A themed party or park is organised around one chosen subject, and the Med is the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Engineer in factory wasting time

indicators.note: wasting time means losing the letter for time from the word for factory

parts.note: a plant is an industrial works

explanation.surface: An engineer working in a factory idles the hours away.
explanation.definitionFit: To engineer something is to devise or contrive it, a verb sense of the synonym used here.

clue.text: Was boss having to shout? That fellow's manner!

parts.note: to rant is to shout angrily
that fellow is he, so that fellow's is a contraction of he is
how means the manner in which something is done

explanation.surface: Someone complains about a superior who has to yell all the time.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for being in charge of an operation and making all the decisions.

clue.text: Insignificance of man with no picture being shot

indicators.note: shot in the sense of ruined or broken up, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A man with no photograph taken feels insignificant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shot' suggests photography alongside picture; here it means wrecked, signalling a rearrangement of MAN, NO and PICTURE.
explanation.definitionFit: Lack of importance is a direct synonym for insignificance.

clue.text: After muddle is getting on sending texts?

indicators.note: the word for getting on comes after the word for muddle

parts.note: a mess is a muddle
aging means getting on in years

explanation.surface: An older person in a mess tries texting.
explanation.definitionFit: Messaging is sending electronic messages, of which texts are one example, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Exclusive groups that could be esoteric

indicators.note: the letters of the next word could be rearranged to give the answer

explanation.surface: Cliques might well be obscure and inward-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: A coterie is a small exclusive circle of people sharing interests.

clue.text: You must be Eve!

parts.note: you is the grammatical form addressing the listener, and Eve was the second human created after Adam

explanation.surface: A greeting to someone recognised as Eve.
explanation.walkthrough: Two senses meet: 'you' is the pronoun of the person addressed in grammar, and in Genesis Eve was the second human being.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar the pronoun you is the form for the addressee, and Eve was literally the second human made.

clue.text: Song from a new boy joining church

indicators.note: the rest joins on after the abbreviation for church

parts.note: a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A newcomer joins the church choir and gets a song.
explanation.definitionFit: Chanson is French for song, used in English for a French art song.

clue.text: Frightened old man cut off, beginning to yell

parts.note: pa is father, the old man
to nick is to cut a small piece off

indicators.note: beginning to picks out the first letter of yell

explanation.surface: A scared elderly man, interrupted, starts to scream.
explanation.definitionFit: Panicky means gripped by sudden fear, a synonym for frightened.

clue.text: Big noise after this person comes to a holy city

indicators.note: the big noise comes after the word for this person

parts.note: the setter refers to themself as this person, me
a din is a loud noise

explanation.surface: A racket follows the speaker to a sacred city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Big noise' suggests an important person; here it is a racket.
explanation.definitionFit: Medina in Saudi Arabia is Islam's second holiest city, burial place of the Prophet.

clue.text: Adult getting cross with member of family around? Chilling out needed

indicators.note: the family member goes around the other letters, holding them inside

parts.note: a relation is a member of one's family
a cross is the letter X
A is the film-classification abbreviation for adult

explanation.surface: A grown-up angry with a visiting relative needs time to unwind.
explanation.definitionFit: Relaxation is rest and leisure, which chilling out describes in informal speech.

clue.text: Scarcely any can be heard — gosh!

indicators.note: signals that the word for scarcely any is spoken, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: few means hardly any

explanation.surface: Almost nothing audible, and someone exclaims in surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are exclamations of relief or astonishment, interchangeable interjections.

clue.text: Quietly be out in front making petition

parts.note: P is piano in music, meaning quietly
to lead is to be ahead of the rest

explanation.surface: Quietly step forward to present a request.
explanation.definitionFit: To petition is to make an earnest request, which is what pleading is.

clue.text: Notes in small-sized manuscript

parts.note: mini means very small

explanation.surface: Jottings written in a tiny manuscript.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Notes' looks like written jottings, but it means musical notes.
explanation.definitionFit: A minim is a musical note lasting two beats, a half note in American usage.

clue.text: Fate of revolutionary captured by the French intelligence service

indicators.note: the revolutionary is captured, held inside the other letters

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for the
SIS is the Secret Intelligence Service, Britain's MI6
Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary

explanation.surface: The destiny of a rebel caught by French spies.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Lachesis is one of the three Fates, the one who measures the thread of life.

clue.text: Silver hair ultimately concealed by a chap

indicators.note: the letter from hair is concealed by, so placed within, the following words

parts.note: a gent is a chap or man

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of hair

explanation.surface: A man hides his grey hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Argent is the heraldic term for silver, also used poetically.

clue.text: Appearing in biography, a desperate group of stars

indicators.note: the answer is appearing in, sitting inside, the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Celebrities who feature in a gloomy life story.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stars' suggests celebrities in a biography; here they are astronomical.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hyades are a star cluster in the constellation Taurus.
